title: Single-comment per device-per-list UX enforcement (Customer View)

requirements.summary: Persist a browser device identifier and enforce one single-comment generation per list per device in the Customer View UI, including disable state and clear English errors, without changing bulk generation behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: On first successful generation for a selected list, the UI stores that the current device has used that list for single generation and prevents further single generations for that list on the same browser/device.

If the backend rejects the request due to the one-per-device-per-list rule (e.g., after clearing local storage or on a second tab), the UI shows a clear English error message and the single-generate button ends up disabled for that list.
The disable/error behavior applies to all users (no admin/user exceptions).
Bulk comment generation UI/behavior remains unchanged.

file_operations.description: Add small localStorage utilities to (1) generate and persist a stable per-browser deviceId and (2) persist/query per-list single-generation usage state (e.g., used listNames set) for the single comment generator flow only.
Update the single comment generation hook to require a deviceId and pass it to the backend generateSingleComment call; keep bulk generation hooks unchanged.

Implement the Customer View single generator restriction: load/ensure deviceId, detect if the selected single list is already used for this device, disable the single-generate button accordingly, persist used-on-success, and on backend rejection show an English error then disable for that list; ensure bulk generator UI/logic is unchanged and do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui.
